integrity: The proof separates a universal analytic tail from an exhaustive finite prefix. The finite prefix is checked by an embedded exact sieve and arbitrary-precision integer comparisons, while the infinite tail is proved symbolically from explicit published inequalities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to square arguments of the prime-counting function and the exponent 1/n. It does not prove analogous root monotonicity at arbitrary powers or the Firoozbakht conjecture. The infinite tail cites the established Montgomery--Vaughan Brun--Titchmarsh inequality and the Rosser--Schoenfeld lower bound rather than reproving them.
title: Strict root monotonicity at square arguments of the prime-counting function
